evidence: Read items/def-estimand-on-a-statistical-model.md: an estimand is a target-valued function on Θ with no implicit measurability; consumers state their metric target separately.
Read items/def-parametric-statistical-model.md: the model is the map θ↦Pθ and need not be injective; the consumer uses that exact convention.

Read items/def-statistical-experiment.md: an experiment is a measurable observation space with a parameter-indexed family of probability measures; no parameter measurability or common sample space is implied.
